monthly.method: Illustrative monthly household basket for 4-5 people, with a 3500 ILS design target, not a statistical average or guaranteed budget. Fixed quantities and candidate priority. Only complete branches are ranked; no missing product is omitted or imputed. Ordinary shelf prices only. Equivalent brands, origin, certification and other disclosed product attributes may differ. Fresh and frozen meat are separate lines. Annual gap is the current monthly gap multiplied by 12, assuming unchanged quantities and price differences; it is not a forecast. File prices do not confirm stock.
